children: MVB Bank is stepping in as the regulated banking infrastructure behind DingoBlu Financial's upcoming Visa debit card program and deposit products. The West Virginia-based bank, which focuses on powering fintech solutions in payments and card issuance, will handle the compliance and banking-services side while DingoBlu builds out the customer-facing technology platform. Planned offerings include checking and savings account options, digital account-management tools and Visa debit card access. Specific product features, rates and fees haven't been disclosed yet, with the company saying details will come closer to launch.
